Heavy Rain Alert Issued for July 8, Red Alert in Several Areas

The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a red alert for heavy rainfall on Wednesday, July 8. Several regions are expected to experience significant downpours. Residents in affected areas are advised to take necessary precautions.
